title: Uniqueness of a matching tree path
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ be a type of output labels, and let a binary decision tree on $n$ coordinates query only coordinates in a specified available set, removing each queried coordinate from the set available to its children. If two paths in the list of paths generated by the tree both agree with the same vector in $\mathbb F_2^n$ at every coordinate they specify, then the two paths are equal.
hypotheses_covered: The tree is a binary decision tree on $n$ coordinates with labels in $\alpha$
The tree is indexed by an available set of coordinates
Both paths belong to the tree's generated path list
Both paths agree with the same vector at all coordinates they specify
